g.title: j2126726525
g.text: Did you truly find yourself so otherwise bereft of options that you resorted to petitioning Roathe to badger me on your behalf in order to... consider an apology?

g.text: RoatheLyonDatingDeal, LyonNoDate

g.title: j3979121195
g.text: You realize how farcical that sounds, yes?

g.title: j3967428600
g.text: I do not wish to waste more time than I have already lost listening to his argument. I will simply say very well.

g.title: j2619645044
g.text: The issue, correct me if I am wrong, was that you did not wish to wade through my past. Now you seem to have changed your mind?

g.title: j1300510244
g.text: I didn't know he said I'd apologize.

g.title: j12516145
g.text: I didn't know what else to do. I know it's ridiculous in hindsight.

g.title: j2169173578
g.text: Check boolean MarieFamilyFail

g.title: j3623553770
g.text: I do not understand. We cannot go back. Those waters cannot be retread.

g.title: j2027845402
g.text: I see.

g.title: j3751924526
g.text: The comical nature of it, I admit, is part of what made me come and investigate. Are you so distraught? I cannot imagine the lack of my companionship in your life is so terrible a thing.

g.title: j1351245872
g.text: You shall have my assistance as you request. I pity what your attack devil will do next to Marie.

g.title: j2169173578->j1351245872
g.text: true

g.title: j836264493
g.text: You shall have my assistance as you request. Now please, call off your attack devil.

g.title: j2169173578->j836264493
g.text: false

g.title: j1426729737
g.text: Oh. Well, this was a massive waste of time then, wasn't it?

g.title: j1944777460
g.text: I guess I... will simply say I am sorry, then. For not listening to you.

g.title: j4273451586
g.text: It is, Lyon. I care about you. Immensely. And I know I misstepped with you badly.

g.title: j92487004
g.text: Boolean LyonFamilySuccess is now true.

g.title: j770168571
g.text: Boolean LyonFamilySuccess is now true.

g.title: j4113935420
g.text: May I ask why you did not? Were you afraid of the subject matter? Bored by it, perhaps? Or did you think you were not strong enough to weather it?

g.title: j1252589167
g.text: And I am so very, very sorry.

g.title: j547953661
g.text: Boolean LyonFamilyFail is now false.

g.title: j3711686580
g.text: Boolean LyonFamilyFail is now false.

g.title: j908579764
g.text: I was afraid of it.

g.title: j1467628395
g.text: I didn't think I was strong enough to take it on.

g.title: j2487495602
g.text: I didn't care at the time. But I do, now.

g.title: j3748034582
g.text: I didn't know what else to do but to turn to Roathe for help.

g.title: Initiate conversation MarieLyonRepair in /Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Dialogue/MarieDialogue_rom.dialogue
g.text: Initiate conversation MarieLyonRepair in /Lotus/Types/Gameplay/1999Wf/Dialogue/MarieDialogue_rom.dialogue

g.title: j3290283582
g.text: Then I have no choice but to forgive you.

g.title: j990534422
g.text: And what has changed that makes you suddenly care, when previously you did not?

g.title: j300637305
g.text: I am left without any other option but to forgive you, of course. I do not know why you would want such a broken thing such as I, cluttering up your spaces.

g.title: j106665696
g.text: Boolean LyonConfessionFail is now false.

g.title: j171227140
g.text: I changed my mind about you.

g.title: j2284160176
g.text: I feel there is progress that might be blocked behind hearing your stories.

g.title: j2560322242
g.text: But I find that my annoyance over your words fades now that I know the absolutely bizarre lengths you will go to have me at your side.

g.title: j2632701785
g.text: A means to an end.
